jobs.description:

To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

Role Overview

As a Backend Engineer in the Money team, you build and maintain backend services behind customer accounts and money movement, working on well-defined tasks with guidance from senior engineers. You write clean, tested code, learn how banking-grade systems stay exact and auditable, and grow quickly toward owning features on your own.

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs for accounts, balances, transfers and payments, following the team's designs and standards.
  • Deliver well-scoped tasks from implementation to production, with unit and integration tests.
  • Follow the rules of money handling: exact amounts, idempotent requests, clear transaction states and audit trails.
  • Help with integrations with banks and payment partners, and with daily batch and reconciliation jobs.
  • Take part in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback, and learn from them.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues with help from senior engineers, and fix them with tests that prevent them from coming back.
  • Write clear technical notes and documentation for the work you do.
  • Ask questions early, raise risks and communicate progress to your team, Product and Operations.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 2+ years of professional backend engineering, including working on services in production.
  • Languages: Solid in Java, Go or another modern backend language.
  • Fundamentals: Good understanding of REST APIs, relational databases and SQL, and basic concurrency.
  • Data & Messaging: Working knowledge of transactions, and exposure to caching (Redis) and messaging (Kafka).
  • Tools: Comfortable with Git, Docker and CI/CD, with exposure to a cloud platform (GCP or AWS).
  • Mindset: Careful, curious and eager to learn, with clear communication. Experience in banking, payments, e-wallets or another regulated environment is a plus but not required.

Role Overview

Trading Risk protects Ajaib and its customers from market, credit and counterparty losses across the platform. Leverage and loan products are embedded in every product we offer, so credit exposure shows up wherever customers trade: margin trading on stocks, leveraged positions, and lending features built into the investing journey.

This makes collection at Ajaib different from a standalone lender. Exposure moves with the market, collateral is liquid and volatile, and a delinquency can open and close within a trading day. You will build a collection function that works at that speed, combining automated margin-call and liquidation logic with human outreach for the cases that need judgement.

You will work closely with Credit Risk, Product, Engineering, Data, Customer Support, Legal and Compliance. At Senior Manager level, you will also lead a team of collection specialists and own collection outcomes at the leadership table.

Collection strategy and policy

  • Design and own the collection strategy across all leverage and loan products, from pre-due reminders and margin calls through early, late and recovery stages.
  • Write and maintain collection policies and SOPs: contact rules, escalation paths, restructuring and settlement criteria, forced-liquidation triggers and write-off thresholds.
  • Segment the delinquent book by risk, balance, collateral cover and customer behaviour, and set a treatment path for each segment.

Margin calls and collateral

  • Work with Trading Risk and Engineering to define margin-call thresholds, cure periods and liquidation rules that balance loss prevention with customer fairness.
  • Monitor collateral shortfalls in real time during volatile markets and coordinate the response when many accounts breach at once.
  • Own the handling of residual debt after liquidation, where collateral does not fully cover the loan.

Operations and channels

  • Run day-to-day collection operations across in-app notifications, push, email, WhatsApp, SMS and calls.
  • Build and test automated, data-driven contact strategies, including timing, channel mix and message content.
  • Select, onboard and manage third-party collection agencies and legal partners, with clear SLAs, incentives and conduct audits.

Analytics and reporting

  • Own collection KPIs: roll rates, cure rates, DPD buckets, recovery rate, cost to collect and net credit loss.
  • Report collection performance and loss forecasts to the Head of Trading Risk and senior leadership.
  • Feed collection insight back into credit limits, margin rules and product design so fewer accounts become delinquent in the first place.

Compliance and conduct

  • Make sure every collection activity follows OJK regulations, consumer protection rules and data privacy law (UU PDP).
  • Handle customer complaints and escalations linked to collection fairly and quickly.
  • Keep complete audit trails for regulators, internal audit and external auditors.

People leadership (Senior Manager level)

  • Hire, coach and lead a team of collection specialists and analysts.
  • Set team targets, quality standards and a culture of firm but respectful collection.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in collection, credit risk or recovery, including 3+ years leading teams.
  • Hands-on experience running collection for digital lending, paylater, margin financing or securities-backed lending in Indonesia.
  • A track record of measurably improving roll rates, recovery rates or credit losses, with numbers you can walk us through.
  • Strong working knowledge of OJK regulations on collection, lending and consumer protection, and of how they apply to securities firms and fintech lenders.
  • Comfort with data: you build and read dashboards, use SQL or Excel to segment portfolios, and run A/B tests on contact strategies.
  • Experience managing third-party collection agencies and holding them to clear performance and conduct standards.
  • Calm, structured decision-making under pressure, especially during sharp market moves.
  • Fluent Bahasa Indonesia and professional working English.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business, statistics or a related field.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a brokerage, crypto exchange or investment platform offering margin or leverage.
  • Familiarity with collection platforms, dialers and decisioning engines, or experience building them with an engineering team.
  • Exposure to collection scoring or behavioural models built with data science teams.

Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.  

To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Product Analyst to support tracking, monitoring, and reporting across our onboarding and login funnels. This role sits close to the data layer — you'll work directly with our database and analytics to keep funnel health visible day-to-day, and know when a number is significant enough to flag to Product rather than just log.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role: not designing the analytics strategy from scratch, but owning the discipline of tracking it well and catching problems early.

Requirements

  • Prior experience as a Product Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role — ideally in a product or growth context
  • Working familiarity with SQL / database querying (comfortable pulling and joining data, not just reading pre-built reports)
  • Hands-on experience with Mixpanel or a comparable product analytics tool (Amplitude, GA4, etc.)
  • Understanding of funnel analysis concepts — conversion rate, drop-off, cohort basics
  • Comfortable working with large spreadsheets (Google Sheets/Excel) for reporting and reconciliation
  • Detail-oriented — able to catch when a number looks "off" before it reaches a dashboard
  • Clear written communication — able to summarize a data finding in a way Product can act on quickly
  • Bonus: prior exposure to fintech, KYC/onboarding flows, or regulated industries
  • Bonus: basic understanding of authentication/security metrics (login success rate, fraud indicators)

Job Descriptions

  • Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly funnel and login metrics dashboards (registration → KYC submission, login success/security metrics, and related product funnels)
  • Query the database and Mixpanel to pull, validate, and reconcile funnel data
  • Maintain and update tracking dashboards and reports on a set cadence
  • Spot anomalies, threshold breaches, or unusual drop-offs in funnel or login data
  • Escalate significant funnel drops or metric anomalies to Product with clear, data-backed context — not just "the number moved," but what stage, what segment, and what it likely means
  • Support ad hoc data pulls and basic analysis requests from Product and other stakeholders
  • Keep tracking documentation (event definitions, dashboard specs, metric definitions) accurate and up to date as the funnel evolves
  • Perform live app testing to gain a thorough, hands-on understanding of our app's user experience and underlying functionality
  • Benchmark our product and onboarding/login flows against competitors to identify industry standards and areas for improvement
  • Conduct necessary research to support funnel optimizations and data-driven product recommendations

Benefits

  • Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
  • Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you
  • Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
  • Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certification
  • Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
  • Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
  • Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
  • Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users

  • Deliver features from technical design to production, with tests, monitoring and alerting.
  • Process transfers and payments exactly once, with clear transaction states, safe retries and complete audit trails.

  • Work with Product, Finance, Operations, Risk and Compliance to turn requirements into reliable solutions.
